description_en: Queries the key policy of a CMK in a KMS instance
description_zh: 查询指定密钥的密钥策略
name: GetKeyPolicy

parameters.help_en:
The ID or Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the key.

When you access a key in another Alibaba Cloud account, you must enter the ARN of the key. The ARN of a key is in the `acs:kms:${region}:${account}:key/${keyid}` format
parameters.help_zh:
密钥ID或密钥资源名称（ARN）。
访问其他阿里云账号下的密钥时，必须输入密钥ARN。密钥ARN的格式为`acs:kms:${region}:${account}:key/${keyid}`
parameters.name: key_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the key policy. Only the static value default is supported
parameters.help_zh: 密钥策略名称。仅支持固定值default
parameters.name: policy_name

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. This ID is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
